title: Piano String
body: The note $$E_{4}$$ is played on a piano and has a frequency of $$f=393.88\, \text{Hz}$$. $$The$$ $$linear$$ $$mass$$ $$density$$ $$of$$ $$this$$ $$string$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$piano$$ $$is$$ $$mu=\$\$0.012\, \tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}}$$ and the string is under a tension of $$1000.00\, \text{N}$$.
